note: THE SAME TRAP AS power_params toe_to_tj, AND THE LARGEST SINGLE LEVER ON THIS SECTOR'S CO2. Pakistani gas is metered and billed on a GROSS calorific basis; every IPCC Table 2.5 factor is on a NET basis. Vol 2 Ch 1: 'for most forms of natural and manufactured gas, the NCV is about 10 percent less'. Applying the gross figure straight to the IPCC factor would inflate residential gas CO2 by about 10 percent. Cross-check: routing the same volume through gas density (~0.75 kg/m3) and the IPCC NCV of 48.0 TJ/Gg gives 1.02 TJ/MMCF, 7 percent above this figure - the spread is real gas-composition variation and is carried in the uncertainty.
